I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the ticket is **PD-4821**. Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09, and the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to it. #central-team's member list includes Tobias. I also mentioned the issue open at the time: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but the store's booking sheet uses 01/02.

I didn't use gbrain this time. Its connection still isn't tied to any member, so it would have blocked the search the same way it did for Hollis. Whoever runs the gbrain server can fix that with `gbrain auth rescope --token *** --member <member>`.
